notes: Born 5 Sep 1943 (Washington marriage records); Ed Simons's tree gives the place as Bend, Oregon. Aged 6 in the 1950 census at Richland; in the 1961 Kennewick High School yearbook; married Paul Carleton Hathaway in Franklin County in May 1962.
Named Roma Florence for her mother's birth mother, Roma Eloise Abernathy, and adoptive mother, Florence (Goodenough) Hinds (family account, 2026).

Married Paul Carleton Hathaway in Franklin County in May 1962 and had two daughters, Amy and Lisa; now married to Theodore "Ted" Walters, and living at Kennewick. Ed Simons, her nephew, is close to her and her daughters (Ed Simons, 2026; county marriage record).
